description:
Port the theme engine from interactive/theme/theme.ts (1141 LOC). Implement:
- Theme struct with ~47 named color keys (ui, markdown, syntax, bash, thinking levels)
- JSON theme loading from dark.json/light.json with variable resolution (vars → color aliases)
- Hex/ANSI/256-color/truecolor conversion to IO.ANSI sequences
- Fluent API: Theme.fg(theme, :accent), Theme.bold(theme, text), etc.
- Runtime theme switching (no file watching needed for MVP)

Upstream: theme/theme.ts, theme/dark.json, theme/light.json, theme/theme-schema.json
Every component below depends on this.
title: Theme system: color palette, JSON schema, runtime switching
